name: form-card
description: A long form in sections that shows each field as a label and a value. A person edits one field in place and sends the changes as one action. A pending action with no receipt offers a retry and a cancel.

parts.name: authorship
parts.description: Type and ID of the author, with a name when available.

parts.name: cancel
parts.description: Button that cancels a confirmation or an action.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: editor
parts.description: Group that contains the field and its controls.

parts.name: form
parts.description: Form that contains the fields and the submit button.

parts.name: lines
parts.description: List of lines in a section.

parts.name: note
parts.description: Reason that a submit sent no action.

parts.name: provenance
parts.description: Group that shows the author and the source.

parts.name: read-only
parts.description: Marker for a value that a person cannot edit.

parts.name: reason
parts.description: Reason for a refusal or an edit error.

parts.name: retry
parts.description: Button that tries the pending action again.

parts.name: save
parts.description: Button that saves a field edit.
